Cohere's models: chat, embeddings, reranking, classification, transcription, document parsing.

## API key

1. Sign in to the [Cohere dashboard](https://dashboard.cohere.com).
2. Open [API keys](https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys). A trial key is free but limited to 1,000 calls a month; create a production key for real use (it needs a card).
3. Copy the key.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add cohere
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
providers: ["cohere"],
```

The app calls `/api/ai/cohere/…` with `createGatewayFetch()`. More in [AI](/docs/agent/ai).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp ai list` shows `cohere` with its key set.

**Rate limits:** Production: 500 calls a minute for Command A chat and most endpoints, rerank 1,000. Trial: 20 chat calls a minute, 1,000 calls a month.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Cohere).
